def score(program: str) -> float:
    n = len(program)
    w = sum(map(ord, program)) / max(n, 1)
    return (n / (n + 900) + (w % 8) / 80) / 1.1

def score(program: str) -> float:
    s = program
    n = len(s) + 1
    a = s.count(' ') / n
    b = s.count('\n') / n
    c = sum(map(ord, s)) / n / 128
    v = 3 * a + 7 * b + c
    return v / (1 + v)
